body:
Sixteen bounded pilots now have retained evidence, but the umbrella issues still mix completed technical work with unobserved learner outcomes. Reconcile #114/#115/#124 criterion by criterion, preserve their open status, and identify five next priorities with four deduplicated follow-up issues.

Retain immutable source inventory (39 Foundations units, 11 Maths for Games units), hashed registry of sixteen pilots plus five supporting reports, exact parent criteria and follow-up bodies. Link the report from README and the coverage map. The next curriculum slice is game-maths probability under #78.

Validation: evidence verifier passes all 61 source hashes, 21 report identities, three live parent criteria/state checks, four live follow-up bodies and 81 local links. Empty registry and wrong-hash negative controls both reject. Ruff check/format and git diff --check pass; Vale reports zero errors/warnings and one advisory word-choice suggestion. Commit hooks ran. No browser/native pilot rerun or learner trial is claimed.

Umbrella: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/114, https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/115, https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/124.
title: Reconcile education pilot evidence and remaining acceptance gaps
